label: Translated Deloria’s spatial metaphysics into Indigenous climate justice
description: Building on Deloria’s spatial-ecological worldview, Whyte defines "collective continuance" as a society’s adaptive capacity rooted in dynamic relationships with land.
dialecticalTension: Brings 1970s Indigenous spatial ontology into Anthropocene ethics.

label: Applied Potawatomi kinship ethics to anthropogenic climate crisis and tipping points
description: Sharing Citizen Potawatomi heritage with Kimmerer, Whyte translates botanical reciprocity into structural climate justice criteria of trust, consent, and accountability.
dialecticalTension: Formalizes Potawatomi kinship ethics inside global environmental policy philosophy.

label: Extended Anishinaabe fossil-capitalism critique into climate colonialism theory
description: Whyte builds on LaDuke’s environmental justice work to frame climate disruption as a continuation of settler-colonial extraction.
dialecticalTension: Links grassroots pipeline resistance with formal environmental philosophy.
